hero.title: P&G · Hair Care Product Packaging
hero.oneLiner: Rethinking the bottle, and the routine around it.

context.text: A P&G-sponsored Northwestern EDI project exploring hair care product packaging through consumer research, synthesis, and prototype exploration.

bullets: A final packaging concept and prototype presentation.

worked: Testing dispensing, handling, and visual cues as distinct questions.
didnt: This was a concept and prototype presentation; commercial performance was not established.

outcome.text: A packaging direction and physical prototype studies.

reflection.text: A bottle's form, dispensing, and place in a routine need to work together.
